correctness.rationale: Newton identities over Z/NZ with 6 invertible reconstruct e1,e2,e3 of each triple, so higher power sums follow for d≥3. Over F_p same power sums force same residual multiset. For a fixed residue pair of triples with r distinct values the mod-p linearized first-three power sums have Vandermonde rank r, yielding exactly p^(6−r) lifts mod p². Counting 6p(p−1)(p−2), 9p(p−1), p residue ordered pairs gives 16p⁶−27p⁵+12p⁴, including repeated-root singular strata. CRT gives cube-free factorization; affine parameter translation averages f and strict convexity fixes equality to character-modulated indicators. Orthogonality gives ||hat{1_M}||_6^6=N^(−2d)J. For d=3, local factors bounded >1 yield decay exactly when ω(N)→∞. Independently enumerated N=5,25,7,49,35: 545,173125,1645,1457407,896525. Infinite p² proof is Vandermonde rank/CRT, not these tests.
